headword: {数十億円|すうじゅうおくえん}
gloss: several billion yen; billions of yen

definitions.gloss: several billion yen; billions of yen
definitions.explanation: An indefinite sum on the order of a few billion yen. Combines {数十|すうじゅう} (several tens) with {億円|おくえん} (hundreds of millions of yen). Common in news about large business deals, investments, or losses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数十億円|すうじゅうおくえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧。
examples.english: Losses will reach several billion yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数十億円|すうじゅうおくえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: This project requires an investment of several billion yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{数十億円|すうじゅうおくえん}⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{買収|ばいしゅう}→買収：04780_baishuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: A major corporation announced an acquisition on the scale of several billion yen.

notes:
Frequently appears in business news and financial reporting. Roughly $20–700 million USD depending on the exchange rate and how many tens are implied.
